name: Dr John Garang Mausoleum
subtitle: The mausoleum and memorial park in Juba honours John Garang, the liberation leader, and has hosted national ceremonies.

facts.label: Independence Day 2011
facts.value: Crowds gathered at the site to celebrate independence

facts.label: Statue
facts.value: A statue honouring Garang and others who died in the war was unveiled on 9 July 2011 (UN video summary, not a direct quote)

facts.label: Public access 2019
facts.value: The army reopened the site to the public in July 2019 after a May closure

facts.label: Public space debate 2021
facts.value: An activist called it a symbol of unity and a public space

parts.text: The mausoleum and memorial park in Juba honours John Garang, the liberation leader, and has hosted national ceremonies. Independence celebrations on 9 July 2011 were held there and a statue was unveiled.
